LESSON: HADITH ON KNOWLEDGE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.1 Hadith on good Behaviour (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub - strand, 
Topic 2.3: Hadith on Knowledge

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Hadith on Knowledge
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to seek knowledge in Islam?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge
2. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge

Teach
• Today’s focus: read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge” using a school example.
• Model B for “read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge
• Model 2: appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge
2. Practise: appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on Knowledge.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to seek knowledge in Islam?
2. What challenges may hinder one from acquiring education?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge
• appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
